title: External Custodian Enrollment, Control Ancestry and Out-of-Band Challenge Claims
controls: Source corpus lineage is explicitly recorded (owned GitHub and 0root.ai mirrors count as one ancestry)
Custodian controller root, operator, administrator, key fingerprint, host and claimed external locator are declared
Challenge issuer root, operator and administrator must differ from both source and custodian declared controllers
Challenge nonce, enrollment ID, custodian ID and signing-key fingerprint are bound across records
Challenge full documentary JSON digest and claimed external evidence digest must agree
Missing out-of-band replay checks, controller authentication, or independent retention assertions fail closed
Even consistent caller-attested records remain unverified real-world external custody
No automated recovery, lock reclaiming or physical ACT
limitations: No externally acquired independently authenticated control records or remote receipts were provided
The Python verifier does not cryptographically verify P-256 signatures or contact an external identity provider
Self-reported boolean enrollment/authentication flags are not physical or independent proof
Names and distinct signatures alone cannot prove distinct ultimate controlling entities
Rust/CI execution and live browser deployment are still unverified
